title: EXPERIMENTAL: EIGHT MORE SWITCHES (STYLE MEDALS, TEAM COMBO, FUEL FIRES, FIVE RAID EVENTS)
why: The experimental page gets eight more switches, all on by default and read when the raid starts. Off: no style medals and no combo ring, no team combo, no fuel fires planned (the fires the debris event lights keep burning), and each of the five raid events (orbital debris, machine convoy, bounty pillager bot, coolant rupture, overseer rampage) leaves the plan, so with all five off a raid has no event.
now: The experimental page switches style medals, team combo, fuel fires and the five raid events.
